unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #64: Add Nano (XNO) as a feeless payment option beside x402 USDC on the query gate. Argued: ACR sells sub-cent data queries and Nano is the only rail where the seller keeps 100% of that price; the autonomous hedger agent already pays for prints and should be able to settle in fee-free Nano.
